caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and installed, initialized and configured as specified in the FIPS 140-2 Compliant Operation Section of the Security Policy and with the entropy token installed as indicated in the Security Policy. Authentication at level 3 is only applicable when identity-based authentication is enforced for the User role. No assurance of the minimum strength of generated keys
description: The FortiGate-VM 6.4 and 7.0 is a software-hybrid module designed to execute on a General Purpose Computer (GPC) hardware platform running the VMware hypervisor. The module provides integrated firewall, VPN, antivirus, antispam, intrusion prevention, content filtering, traffic shaping, and HA capabilities.
